name: app-icon-set-on-dark-phone-home-screen-close-up
title: Colourful gradient app icons on a dark home screen shown in perspective
whatItIs: An angled close-up of a black phone whose home screen shows a grid of varied gradient app icons (orbs, faces, spirals, geometric shapes) with white labels.
whatItMeans: Vibrant and inventive; each icon is a mini artwork, and the dark screen makes them glow.
techniques: Show icons in context on a real home screen.
Give each icon its own gradient, shape and personality.
Use extreme perspective to make the grid dynamic.
Keep the background dark and unfussy.

vocabulary.definition: A layout of app icons on a home screen.
An icon filled with a colour blend.
A close, angled view of a device.
The small app name under each icon.
